scope.authentication: synthetic test sessions; CSRF measured separately by real browser tests
scope.transport: Flask test client including application validation, SQL and JSON serialization; excludes ingress/TLS latency
scope.fts_hit_count: Exact below 10000; declared lower bound above 10000 with exact has_next for each returned page

limitations: Synthetic storage expansion does not measure million-row parsing or enrichment throughput
Memory/CPU values cover coordinator only, not Docker analysis service
Single bounded report timing is not a report latency distribution
No company SLO agreed; measurements are evidence for sizing, not a production capacity promise
